title: Whores of the Wildwood, Elite Wood Elf Archers. 1.0.0
author: Dwjliel
description:
Please enjoy this balanced but naughty Elite Asrai Archer.

Their models are nicely varied and show some personality!

You might look at their stat card and think pffft - whats the point, almost identical to Waywatchers!

Well, all the difference is in the under-the-hood code: they have incredible aim and don't do friendly damage.

I have designed them to have a different flavour profile to Waywatchers, see their stats card img - note their Wildwood Ranger passive makes them good vs Terror causing units, and with a higher charge bonus they reward you reacting to your lines being threatened more than Waywatchers more passive style. Compared to Waywatchers these girls are designed to sit behind your lines and rain hell down, and be less skirmishy. They benefit from the Kingsglade Landmark.

Early game they'll perform Similarly to Waywatcher but with Magic Damage and a better AP ratio, these girls really come into their own late game.

They also recruit in 1 turn - I often dont play with elite units as the recruit turns put me off, so I figured I'd just remove that barrier.
